# Stepan Turchenko

> AI integration specialist, fullstack engineer, tech lead and consultant.

Stepan Turchenko brings AI agents and automation into business (Claude Code, AI agents, agent harnesses, workflow automation) and owns the creation of IT products from scratch: mobile, web, serverless, Telegram bots, agentic systems, analytics and infrastructure. Sixth year helping IT companies worldwide reach their goals across the US, Europe and Russia.

## Results delivered
- 2 large products in the USA taken to market.
- 8 mid-size businesses in Russia taken to market.
- 24 sites and apps helping entrepreneurs.
- 100+ agents and harnesses automating business processes.

## What he does
- AI integration: builds AI agents and the harnesses around them and wires them into existing tools and workflows - shared memory, rules, skills and scheduled agents that take over routine work in product, finance, QA and analytics.
- Builds IT products from scratch: mobile and backend, payments, analytics, infrastructure, release, and the team around it.
- Tech lead and consulting: owns the product and the whole technical side, runs interviews and negotiations in English.

## Selected work
- Painta (https://painta.io): an AI art coach built as a full product - mobile app, backend, payments, and automations.
- Aspect Health (https://www.aspect-health.com): a Delaware women-health platform with an AI app, run as a heavy production service.
- Nana800 (http://nana800.io): his own low-code automation platform with visual scenarios, integrations, and AI blocks.
- Moscow Sport (https://sport.mos.ru/): the Moscow government sport app.

## What he uses
AI & Automation: Claude Code, AI Agents, Prompt Engineering, N8N, Cursor, AI workflow automation.
Frontend & Mobile: React, React Native, TypeScript, Zustand, Expo.
Backend & Data: Node.js, Nest.js, Next.js, PostgreSQL, MongoDB, Supabase, Redis, RabbitMQ, Microservices.
DevOps & Cloud: Docker, Dokploy, CI/CD, Google Cloud, AWS, Grafana, Loki, Nginx, Traefik.
W3-certified in TypeScript and React. Fluent in English. Hackathon prize winner, 2022.
